	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "CharacterRotation", meta = (HideSelfPin = "true"))
	void TurnInPlace_Rotating();
</code></pre>
<pre><code>	//当前为手柄输入
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Input")
	bool bIsGamepadInput = false;
</code></pre>
<pre><code>void UBaseAnimInstance::UpdateLeftFootUp()
{
	USkeletalMeshComponent* OwningComponent = GetOwningComponent();
	APawn* PawnOwner = TryGetPawnOwner();
	if (OwningComponent == nullptr || PawnOwner == nullptr)
	{
		bIsLeftFootUp = false;
		return;
	}

	static const FName LeftFootSocketName(TEXT("foot_l"));
	static const FName RightFootSocketName(TEXT("foot_r"));

	const FVector LeftFootDirection =
		OwningComponent-&gt;GetSocketLocation(LeftFootSocketName).GetSafeNormal2D(0.0001f);
	const FVector RightFootDirection =
		OwningComponent-&gt;GetSocketLocation(RightFootSocketName).GetSafeNormal2D(0.0001f);
	const FVector VelocityDirection =
		PawnOwner-&gt;GetVelocity().GetSafeNormal2D(0.0001f);
	//局部速度方向
	const FVector LocalVelocityDirection =
		OwningComponent-&gt;GetComponentRotation().UnrotateVector(VelocityDirection);

	const float LeftFootDot =
		FVector::DotProduct(LeftFootDirection, LocalVelocityDirection);
	const float RightFootDot =
		FVector::DotProduct(LocalVelocityDirection, RightFootDirection);

	bIsLeftFootUp = LeftFootDot &gt; RightFootDot;
}
</code></pre>
<h1 id="part-01-自定义数据类型枚举和结构体">Part 01 自定义数据类型：枚举和结构体</h1>
<pre><code class="language-C++">// Fill out your copyright notice in the Description page of Project Settings.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "BaseControllerData.generated.h"

/*
 *移动方向枚举
 */
UENUM(BlueprintType)
enum class ECardinalDirection : uint8
{
	Backward	UMETA(DisplayName = "Backward"),
	Forward		UMETA(DisplayName = "Forward"),
	Left		UMETA(DisplayName = "Left"),
	Right		UMETA(DisplayName = "Right")
};

/*
 *步态枚举
 */
UENUM(BlueprintType)
enum class EGroundGait : uint8
{
	Idle	UMETA(DisplayName = "Idle"),
	Walk	UMETA(DisplayName = "Walk"),
	Run		UMETA(DisplayName = "Run")
};

/*
 *步态参数
 */
USTRUCT(BlueprintType)
struct FSGaitSettings
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Gait")
	float StandingSpeed = 0;

	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Gait")
	float Acceleration = 0;

	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Gait")
	float BrakingDeceleration = 0;

	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Gait")
	float BrakingFrictionFactor = 0;

	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Gait")
	bool bUseSeparateBrakingFriction = false;

	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Gait")
	float BrakingFriction = 0;

	UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Gait")
	float GroundFriction = 0;
};

/*
 *旋转模式枚举
 */
UENUM(BlueprintType)
enum class ERotationMode : uint8
{
	Rotating	UMETA(DisplayName = "Rotating"),
	Strafing	UMETA(DisplayName = "Strafing")
};
</code></pre>
<h1 id="part02-设置角色初始步态和旋转模式">Part02 设置角色初始步态和旋转模式</h1>
<h2 id="用到的变量及默认值">用到的变量及默认值</h2>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//步态
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = Gait)
	TMap&lt;EGroundGait, FSGaitSettings&gt; GaitSettings;
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = Gait)
	EGroundGait CurrentGroundGait;
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = Gait)
	EGroundGait PreviousGroundGait;
	//旋转模式
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = RotationMode)
	ERotationMode CurrentRotationMode;
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = RotationMode)
	ERotationMode PreviousRotationMode;

	//Anim实例
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = Anim)
	UAnimInstance* MainAnimInstance;
</code></pre>
<p>从RootMotion动画分析器可以看到，WalkLoop速度169.92，RunLoop速度386.19，因此可以设置一个接近的MaxWalkSpeed</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260904171700920-473450955.png" alt="1788488074605" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void ABaseController::InitialGaitSettings()
{
	FSGaitSettings WalkSettings;
	WalkSettings.MaxWalkSpeed = 175.0f;
	WalkSettings.MaxAcceleration = 350.0f;
	WalkSettings.BrakingDeceleration = 500.0f;
	WalkSettings.BrakingFrictionFactor = 1.0f;
	WalkSettings.bUseSeparateBrakingFriction = true;
	WalkSettings.BrakingFriction = 0.0f;
	WalkSettings.GroundFriction = 8.0f;
	GaitSettings.Add(EGroundGait::Walk, WalkSettings);

	FSGaitSettings RunSettings;
	RunSettings.MaxWalkSpeed = 375.0f;
	RunSettings.MaxAcceleration = 800.0f;
	RunSettings.BrakingDeceleration = 1200.0f;
	RunSettings.BrakingFrictionFactor = 1.0f;
	RunSettings.bUseSeparateBrakingFriction = true;
	RunSettings.BrakingFriction = 0.0f;
	RunSettings.GroundFriction = 8.0f;
	GaitSettings.Add(EGroundGait::Run, RunSettings);
}

// Sets default values
ABaseController::ABaseController()
{
 	// Set this character to call Tick() every frame.  You can turn this off to improve performance if you don't need it.
	PrimaryActorTick.bCanEverTick = true;

	InitialGaitSettings();
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="beginplay">BeginPlay</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202608/3614909-20260831184043829-782267344.png" alt="1788168092090" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void ABaseController::SetMainAnimInstance()
{
	MainAnimInstance = GetMesh()-&gt;GetAnimInstance();
}
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void ABaseController::SetGroundGait(EGroundGait NewGroundGait)
{
	if (CurrentGroundGait == NewGroundGait)
	{
		return;
	}

	//更新步态
	PreviousGroundGait = CurrentGroundGait;
	CurrentGroundGait = NewGroundGait;

	//更新CharacterMovement组件属性
	const FSGaitSettings* GaitSetting = GaitSettings.Find(CurrentGroundGait);
	UCharacterMovementComponent* MovementComponent = GetCharacterMovement();
	if (GaitSetting == nullptr || MovementComponent == nullptr)
	{
		return;
	}

	MovementComponent-&gt;MaxWalkSpeed = GaitSetting-&gt;MaxWalkSpeed;
	MovementComponent-&gt;MaxAcceleration = GaitSetting-&gt;MaxAcceleration;
	MovementComponent-&gt;BrakingDecelerationWalking = GaitSetting-&gt;BrakingDeceleration;
	MovementComponent-&gt;BrakingFrictionFactor = GaitSetting-&gt;BrakingFrictionFactor;
	MovementComponent-&gt;bUseSeparateBrakingFriction = GaitSetting-&gt;bUseSeparateBrakingFriction;
	MovementComponent-&gt;BrakingFriction = GaitSetting-&gt;BrakingFriction;
	MovementComponent-&gt;GroundFriction = GaitSetting-&gt;GroundFriction;
}
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void ABaseController::SetRotationMode(ERotationMode NewRotationMode)
{
	if (CurrentRotationMode == NewRotationMode)
	{
		return;
	}

	//更新旋转模式
	PreviousRotationMode = CurrentRotationMode;
	CurrentRotationMode = NewRotationMode;
}
</code></pre>

<h2 id="动画蓝图">动画蓝图</h2>

<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260901174246607-255727319.png" alt="1788244875571" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">public:
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Reference")
	ABaseController* AsBaseController = nullptr;
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Reference")
	UCharacterMovementComponent* MovementComponent = nullptr;
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Reference")
	float DeltaTimeX = 0.0f;

	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterMovement")
	float GroundSpeed = 0.0f;
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterState")
	bool bIsMoving = false;
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterRotation")
	FRotator LastVelocityRotation = FRotator::ZeroRotator;
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterRotation")
	FRotator LastInputRotation = FRotator::ZeroRotator;
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterState")
	bool bHasInput = false;

	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterMovement")
	EGroundGait GroundGait = EGroundGait::Idle;

	//计算动画蓝图需要的参数
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "UpdateData")
	void UpdateEssentialData();

	//更新地面步态
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "UpdateData")
	void UpdateGroundGait();
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void UBaseAnimInstance::UpdateEssentialData()
{
	if (MovementComponent == nullptr)
	{
		GroundSpeed = 0.0f;
		bIsMoving = false;
		bHasInput = false;
		return;
	}

	//Sequence 0:
	const FVector Velocity = MovementComponent-&gt;Velocity;
	GroundSpeed = Velocity.Size2D();
	bIsMoving = GroundSpeed &gt; 1.0f;
	if (bIsMoving)
	{
		LastVelocityRotation = Velocity.Rotation();
	}

	//Sequence 1:
	bHasInput = MovementComponent-&gt;GetAnalogInputModifier() &gt; 0.0f;
	if (bHasInput)
	{
		LastInputRotation = MovementComponent-&gt;GetLastInputVector().Rotation();
	}

}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>适配手柄：摇杆推进自动切换步态</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void UBaseAnimInstance::UpdateGroundGait()
{
	if (MovementComponent == nullptr)
	{
		return;
	}

	//速度与加速度反向时应该转身
	const FVector NormalizedVelocity =
		MovementComponent-&gt;Velocity.GetSafeNormal(0.0001f);
	const FVector NormalizedAcceleration =
		MovementComponent-&gt;GetCurrentAcceleration().GetSafeNormal(0.0001f);
	const bool bShouldTurn =
		FVector::DotProduct(NormalizedVelocity, NormalizedAcceleration) &lt; -0.5f;


	if (MovementComponent-&gt;IsFalling())
	{
		GroundGait = EGroundGait::Idle;
		return;
	}
  
	//根据移动速度和推入系数判断是否可以切换到Run
	const bool bCanRun =
		bIsMoving
		&amp;&amp; MovementComponent-&gt;GetMaxSpeed() &gt; 250.0f
		&amp;&amp; MovementComponent-&gt;GetAnalogInputModifier() &gt; 0.6f;

	if (bCanRun)
	{
		GroundGait = bShouldTurn ? EGroundGait::Idle : EGroundGait::Run;
		return;
	}

	const bool bCanWalk =
		bIsMoving
		&amp;&amp; MovementComponent-&gt;GetMaxSpeed() &gt; 50.0f
		&amp;&amp; MovementComponent-&gt;GetAnalogInputModifier() &gt; 0.01f;

	GroundGait = bCanWalk &amp;&amp; !bShouldTurn
		? EGroundGait::Walk
		: EGroundGait::Idle;
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>UpdateGroundGait函数中：<br>
切换为移动时转向的逻辑，用move-idle-move来实现</p>
</blockquote>

<h1 id="part04-移动停止选择器表">Part04 移动停止+选择器表</h1>
<h2 id="判断左脚是否抬起也就是左脚是否在前">判断左脚是否抬起(也就是左脚是否在前)</h2>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterState")
	bool bIsLeftFootUp = false;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//更新移动方向上的领先脚
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "UpdateData")
	void UpdateLeftFootUp();
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void UBaseAnimInstance::UpdateLeftFootUp()
{
	USkeletalMeshComponent* OwningComponent = GetOwningComponent();
	APawn* PawnOwner = TryGetPawnOwner();
	if (OwningComponent == nullptr || PawnOwner == nullptr)
	{
		bIsLeftFootUp = false;
		return;
	}

	static const FName LeftFootSocketName(TEXT("foot_l"));
	static const FName RightFootSocketName(TEXT("foot_r"));

	//局部左脚方向
	const FVector LeftFootDirection =
		OwningComponent
			-&gt;GetSocketTransform(LeftFootSocketName, RTS_Component)
			.GetLocation()
			.GetSafeNormal2D(0.0001f);
	//局部右脚方向
	const FVector RightFootDirection =
		OwningComponent
			-&gt;GetSocketTransform(RightFootSocketName, RTS_Component)
			.GetLocation()
			.GetSafeNormal2D(0.0001f);
	const FVector VelocityDirection =
		PawnOwner-&gt;GetVelocity().GetSafeNormal2D(0.0001f);
	//局部速度方向
	const FVector LocalVelocityDirection =
		OwningComponent-&gt;GetComponentRotation().UnrotateVector(VelocityDirection);

	const float LeftFootDot =
		FVector::DotProduct(LeftFootDirection, LocalVelocityDirection);
	const float RightFootDot =
		FVector::DotProduct(LocalVelocityDirection, RightFootDirection);

	bIsLeftFootUp = LeftFootDot &gt; RightFootDot;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="动画序列添加distance曲线修改器">动画序列添加Distance曲线修改器</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260901174248546-1756897093.png" alt="1788252857284" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>创建Uniform Indexable曲线压缩设置资产并分配到这些动画序列</p>
<blockquote>
<p>如果打包后的游戏要运行：</p>
<ul>
<li>Distance Match to Target</li>
<li>Advance Time by Distance Matching</li>
<li>其他依赖 FAnimCurveBufferAccess 的距离匹配功能</li>
</ul>
<p>那么相关动画的曲线必须使用 Uniform Indexable 压缩。否则编辑器里可能正常，打包后距离曲线查询可能失效，出现动画时间为 0、距离匹配不正确等问题。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260901174249092-1830546549.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>

<h3 id="animsetup_stop">AnimSetup_Stop</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260904171702412-1584749210.png" alt="1788493445480" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>根据不同速度决定Stop动画的起始播放时间，而不是依赖同步组(参考Lyra，Stop和Locomotion并不是同一个同步组)</p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//根据 GroundSpeed 计算Stop动画起始播放时间
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintPure, Category = "Animation", meta = (BlueprintThreadSafe, HideSelfPin = "true"))
	float SetStopAnimStartTime(
		float LowSpeedStartTime = 1.8f,
		float MediumSpeedStartTime = 1.5f,
		float HighSpeedStartTime = 0.0f) const;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">float UBaseAnimInstance::SetStopAnimStartTime(
	const float LowSpeedStartTime,
	const float MediumSpeedStartTime,
	const float HighSpeedStartTime) const
{
	if (GroundSpeed &lt; 300.0f)
	{
		return LowSpeedStartTime;
	}

	if (GroundSpeed &lt;= 400.0f)
	{
		return MediumSpeedStartTime;
	}

	return HighSpeedStartTime;
}
</code></pre>

<h3 id="event-blueprintupdateanimation">Event BlueprintUpdateAnimation</h3>

<h4 id="movingrotation">MovingRotation</h4>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260904171704818-1493213554.png" alt="1788512728127" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterRotation")
	ERotationMode RotationMode = ERotationMode::Rotating;
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterState")
	bool bIsStrafing = false;

	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterRotation")
	FRotator PrimaryRotation = FRotator::ZeroRotator;

	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Curve")
	FName RotateCurveName = FName("RotateAlpha");
	//需要修正的总旋转角度
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterRotation")
	float StartAngle = 0.0f;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//Rotating模式下的旋转逻辑
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "CharacterRotation", meta = (HideSelfPin = "true"))
	void SmoothVelocityRotation(float TargetInterpSpeed, float ActorInterpSpeed);

	//Strafing模式下的旋转逻辑
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "CharacterRotation", meta = (HideSelfPin = "true"))
	void SmoothControlRotation(float TargetInterpSpeed, float ActorInterpSpeed);
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void UBaseAnimInstance::SmoothVelocityRotation(const float TargetInterpSpeed, const float ActorInterpSpeed)
{
	//PrimaryRotation = LastVelocityRotation
	PrimaryRotation = FMath::RInterpConstantTo(
		PrimaryRotation,
		LastVelocityRotation,
		DeltaTimeX,
		TargetInterpSpeed);

	if (AsBaseController == nullptr)
	{
		return;
	}

	//抵消：动画曲线RotateCurve带来的旋转偏移量
	const float RotateAlpha = GetCurveValue(RotateCurveName);
	FRotator TargetActorRotation = PrimaryRotation;
	TargetActorRotation.Yaw =
		PrimaryRotation.Yaw - RotateAlpha * StartAngle;

	const FRotator NewActorRotation = FMath::RInterpTo(
		AsBaseController-&gt;GetActorRotation(),
		TargetActorRotation,
		DeltaTimeX,
		ActorInterpSpeed);

	AsBaseController-&gt;SetActorRotation(NewActorRotation);
}

void UBaseAnimInstance::SmoothControlRotation(const float TargetInterpSpeed, const float ActorInterpSpeed)
{
	if (AsBaseController == nullptr)
	{
		return;
	}

	//PrimaryRotation = ControlRotation.Yaw
	const FRotator ControlRotation = AsBaseController-&gt;GetControlRotation();
	const FRotator TargetRotation(0.0f, ControlRotation.Yaw, 0.0f);
	PrimaryRotation = FMath::RInterpConstantTo(
		PrimaryRotation,
		TargetRotation,
		DeltaTimeX,
		TargetInterpSpeed);

	//ActorRotation =&gt; PrimaryRotation
	const FRotator NewActorRotation = FMath::RInterpTo(
		AsBaseController-&gt;GetActorRotation(),
		PrimaryRotation,
		DeltaTimeX,
		ActorInterpSpeed);

	AsBaseController-&gt;SetActorRotation(NewActorRotation);
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>为什么计算用VelocityRotation的PrimaryRotation用<code>RInterpConstantTo</code>：</p>
<p>起步瞬间假设：</p>
<pre><code>ActorRotation       = 0°
LastInputRotation   = 90°
LastVelocityRotation= 0°
</code></pre>
<p><code>AnimSetup_Start</code> 先计算：</p>
<pre><code>PrimaryRotation = 90°
StartAngle      = 90°
</code></pre>
<p>原来的 <code>RInterpTo(..., 800)</code> 随后让 <code>PrimaryRotation</code> 一帧跳向旧速度方向：</p>
<pre><code>PrimaryRotation：90° → 0°
</code></pre>
<p>Start 开头 <code>RotateAlpha = 1</code>：</p>
<pre><code>TargetActorYaw
= PrimaryRotation - RotateAlpha × StartAngle
= 0° - 1 × 90°
= -90°
</code></pre>
<p>Actor 自己使用 <code>RInterpTo(..., 25)</code>。60 FPS 下：</p>
<pre><code>Alpha = 25 / 60 ≈ 0.4167
ActorYaw = 0° + (-90°) × 0.4167
         ≈ -37.5°
</code></pre>
<p>所以首帧角色被反向拉到大约 <code>-37.5°</code>。随后速度方向更新到新输入方向，<code>PrimaryRotation</code> 又跳回去，Actor 再往正确方向回拉，这就是“抽身”。</p>
<p>改成 <a target="_blank">BaseAnimInstance.cpp (line 148)</a> 中的 <code>RInterpConstantTo</code> 后：</p>
<pre><code>PrimaryRotation：90° → 76.67°
TargetActorYaw：76.67° - 90° = -13.33°
Actor 首帧：约 -5.56°
</code></pre>
<p>反向误差被限制在很小的范围，不再产生明显抽身。</p>
<p>严格来说，<code>RInterpConstantTo</code> 也可能一帧到达目标，例如剩余角度小于 <code>800 × DeltaTime</code>。但它不会因为 <code>800 &gt; 帧率</code> 就无条件吸附；这是两者最根本的区别。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="nomovingrotation">NoMovingRotation</h4>

<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260907151710182-1261351427.gif" alt="1788748754207" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="part07-曲线过渡和伪回转运动">Part07 曲线过渡和伪回转运动</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>出现问题：Start状态下开始转身前会有个抽身的动作<br>
原因：动画的转向角度是死的，角色实际转向角度是活的，因此需要利用RotateAlpha曲线对StartAngle值进行缩放。曲线是从1开始衰减到0的，但是状态机过渡时会对曲线值也进行过渡操作，为了解决这个问题需要引入DeadBlending节点过滤掉不需要blend的动画曲线</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="引入deadblending节点">引入DeadBlending节点</h2>
<p>打印RotateAlpha曲线值可以发现，RotateAlpha是从0开始变化到1再衰减为0的，而不是直接从1开始衰减，这就会导致前半段出现抽身的动作</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260907151710683-1137562493.png" alt="1788749885721" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>因此在动画蓝图中需要在最后加一个DeadBlending节点，用于屏蔽状态机过渡时的曲线值过渡</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260907151710923-1133515554.png" alt="1788750789389" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="效果-3">效果</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260907151712472-518303694.gif" alt="1788765420733" loading="lazy"></p>

<h1 id="part09-解决手柄输入不满时的滑步问题">Part09 解决手柄输入不满时的滑步问题</h1>
<h2 id="角色蓝图-1">角色蓝图</h2>
<h3 id="引入死区">引入死区</h3>
<p>InputGraph.IA_Move中根据阈值过滤手柄输入的 X/Y 轴</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260908120641575-489220926.png" alt="1788839013796" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//根据阈值过滤手柄输入的 X/Y 轴
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintPure, Category = "Input", meta = (HideSelfPin = "true"))
	FVector2D FilterGamepadValue(const FVector2D&amp; InputActionValue, float LowerThreshold) const;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">FVector2D ABaseController::FilterGamepadValue(const FVector2D&amp; InputActionValue, float LowerThreshold) const
{
	return FVector2D(
		FMath::Abs(InputActionValue.X) &gt; LowerThreshold ? InputActionValue.X : 0.0f,
		FMath::Abs(InputActionValue.Y) &gt; LowerThreshold ? InputActionValue.Y : 0.0f);
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="imc_default中的手柄move输入加上死区修改器">IMC_Default中的手柄Move输入加上死区修改器</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260908120642111-928204690.png" alt="1788785817420" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="动画蓝图-2">动画蓝图</h2>
<p><code>MotionSpeed</code>曲线控制动画播放速率AnimPlayRate</p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//动画播放速率
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "AnimPlayRate")
	float AnimPlaySpeed = 1.0f;
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Curve")
	FName SpeedCurveName = FName("MotionSpeed");
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void UBaseAnimInstance::UpdateEssentialData()
{
	//Sequence 0:	RotationMode
	if (AsBaseController != nullptr)
	{
		RotationMode = AsBaseController-&gt;CurrentRotationMode;
	}

	if (MovementComponent != nullptr)
	{
		//Sequence 1:	bIsMoving	LastVelocityRotation
		const FVector Velocity = MovementComponent-&gt;Velocity;
		GroundSpeed = Velocity.Size2D();
		bIsMoving = GroundSpeed &gt; 1.0f;
		if (bIsMoving)
		{
			LastVelocityRotation = Velocity.Rotation();
		}

		//Sequence 2:	bHasInput	LastInputRotation
		bHasInput = MovementComponent-&gt;GetAnalogInputModifier() &gt; 0.0f;
		if (bHasInput)
		{
			LastInputRotation = MovementComponent-&gt;GetLastInputVector().Rotation();
		}
	}

	//Sequence 3:	bIsStrafing
	if (AsBaseController != nullptr)
	{
		bIsStrafing = RotationMode != ERotationMode::Rotating;
	}

	//Sequence 4:	AnimPlaySpeed
	const double SpeedRatio = UKismetMathLibrary::SafeDivide(
		GroundSpeed,
		GetCurveValue(SpeedCurveName));
	AnimPlaySpeed = static_cast&lt;float&gt;(
		FMath::Clamp(SpeedRatio, 0.8, 1.0)
		);
}
</code></pre>
<p>Start State的序列播放器PlayRate绑定AnimPlaySpeed参数传入，并且设置播放起点为0.1(防止起步动画开头顿一下)</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260908120642322-208262477.png" alt="1788840327011" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="动画序列添加motionspeed曲线">动画序列添加MotionSpeed曲线</h2>

<h1 id="part13-rotating模式下的原地转身">Part13 Rotating模式下的原地转身</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>TurnInPlace</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="动画蓝图-3">动画蓝图</h2>
<p>UpdateCharacterRotation.NoMovingRotation</p>
<p>也就是不移动时的旋转逻辑中加入Rotating模式下的原地转身：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260916115603593-221198740.png" alt="1789530446453" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//旋转模式下的原地转身
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterState")
	bool bIsShouldTurnInPlace = false;
	/原地转身的角度
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterRotation")
	double TurnInPlaceAngle = 0.0;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//Rotating模式下,计算原地转身State需要的数据
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "CharacterRotation", meta = (HideSelfPin = "true"))
	void UpdateStateData_TurnInPlace();
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void UBaseAnimInstance::UpdateStateData_TurnInPlace()
{
	bShouldTurnInPlace_Rotating = false;

	if (!IsValid(AsBaseController) || GroundGait != EGroundGait::Idle)
	{
		return;
	}

	FRotator TargetRotation = (AsBaseController-&gt;bShouldAim) ? AsBaseController-&gt;GetControlRotation() : PrimaryRotation;


	TurnInPlaceAngle_Rotating = UKismetMathLibrary::NormalizedDeltaRotator(
		TargetRotation,
		AsBaseController-&gt;GetActorRotation()
		).Yaw;

	bShouldTurnInPlace_Rotating = FMath::Abs(TurnInPlaceAngle_Rotating) &gt; 60.0;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="turninplace-state">TurnInPlace State</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260914211913835-1278417216.png" alt="1789373026727" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p><em><strong>紫色：WantToTurnInPlace</strong></em><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260910210717227-262399486.png" alt="img" loading="lazy"></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><em><strong>把原先的Cycle-&gt;Start的跳转条件WantToStop改为连到Cycle-&gt;Stop，否则这里会出现bug：</strong></em><br>
当角色进入CycleState，这时候松开移动输入键会进入StartState，而StartState相关联的AnimSetup_Start函数会更新PrimaryRotation，导致TurnInPlaceAngle = PrimaryRotation-Actor.Rotation &gt; 60，触发ShouldTurnInPlace==true而进入TurnInPlaceState</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="ct_turninplacestate">CT_TurnInPlaceState</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260910210717443-1737518646.png" alt="1789044625015" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="part14-解决turninplacestate播放动画rootmotion不起作用">Part14 解决TurnInPlaceState播放动画RootMotion不起作用</h1>
<p>原因：动画蓝图的默认设置中RootMotion是仅蒙太奇启用</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260910210717770-460377420.png" alt="1789031623684" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>因此需要让原地转身动画在旋转期间回调动画通知对RootMotion进行设置：</p>
<p>Begin——设置RootMotion From Everything</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260910210718047-1274499471.png" alt="1789044913067" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>End——恢复为RootMotion From Montages Only</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260910210718302-1427823932.png" alt="1789044919400" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>Tick——如果有输入，就立刻恢复为RootMotion From Montages Only，从而打断原地转身动画</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260910210718541-309706914.png" alt="1789044923580" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在原地转身动画资产中添加该AnimNotifyState(最好是在root的z轴旋转不再变化时结束)：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260910210718917-249635152.png" alt="1789045157828" loading="lazy"></p>

<h1 id="part15-键盘输入时转身start对步态切换的限制">Part15 键盘输入时转身Start对步态切换的限制</h1>

<p>转身Start的时候切换步态的动作衔接问题：<br>

<h2 id="skeleton中添加disableswitchgroundgait曲线">Skeleton中添加DisableSwitchGroundGait曲线</h2>
<p>在Skeleton中添加曲线DisableSwitchGroundGait，只有当DisableSwitchGroundGait==0的时候才能够切换步态</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260911190043319-1860520479.png" alt="1789123838351" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="利用rotatealpha曲线来赋值disableswitchgroundgait曲线">利用RotateAlpha曲线来赋值DisableSwitchGroundGait曲线</h2>
<p>因为是StartState出现的步态切换动作衔接问题</p>
<p>因此在StartState中添加ModifyCurve节点，并且用转身起步动画资产中的RotateAlpha曲线来赋值DisableSwitchGroundGait曲线：</p>
<p>RotateAlpha有值的时候禁止切换步态，即DisableSwitchGroundGait=1</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260911190043573-1067139253.png" alt="1789123963256" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>InputGraph.GaitAction：只有DisableSwitchGroundGait==0的时候才能切换步态</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260911190043945-2048742590.png" alt="1789124007972" loading="lazy"></p>

<h2 id="角色蓝图基类">角色蓝图基类</h2>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "Input")
	bool bShouldAim = false;
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260911173943639-1449001572.png" alt="1789118088241" loading="lazy"></p>

<h2 id="动画蓝图-4">动画蓝图</h2>
<p>UpdateCharacterRotation.NoMovingRotation</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260916115604104-520736951.png" alt="1789529980164" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//蒙太奇原地转身角度
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "TurnInPlace_Montage")
	float TurnInPlaceAngle_Montage = 0.0;

	//限制TurnInPlace的播放速度
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "TurnInPlace_Montage")
	float ScaledPlayRate_Montage = 1.0f;
	//限制TurnInPlace的旋转修正倍率
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "TurnInPlace_Montage")
	float TurnInPlaceAngleModifier_Montage;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//播放原地转身动画蒙太奇并应用旋转曲线控制实际角色转身角度
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "CharacterRotation", meta = (HideSelfPin = "true"))
	void TurnInPlace_Montage(TSoftObjectPtr&lt;UChooserTable&gt; CT_TurnInPlace_Montage);
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void UBaseAnimInstance::TurnInPlace_Montage(TSoftObjectPtr&lt;UChooserTable&gt; CT_TurnInPlace_Montage)
{
	static const FName EnableTurnInPlaceCurveName(TEXT("EnableTurnInPlace"));
	static const FName RotationAmountCurveName(TEXT("RotationAmount"));
	static const FName SlotName(TEXT("TurnInPlace_Montage"));

	// Sequence Then 0: Chooser 同时更新 ScaledPlayRate，再使用该值播放蒙太奇。
	if (GetCurveValue(EnableTurnInPlaceCurveName) == 1.0f &amp;&amp; AsBaseController-&gt;bShouldAim)
	{
		TurnInPlaceAngle_Montage = UKismetMathLibrary::NormalizedDeltaRotator(
			AsBaseController-&gt;GetControlRotation(), AsBaseController-&gt;GetActorRotation()).Yaw;

		if (FMath::Abs(TurnInPlaceAngle_Montage) &gt; 60.0f)
		{
			if (UChooserTable* ChooserTable = CT_TurnInPlace_Montage.LoadSynchronous())
			{
				UAnimSequenceBase* Animation = Cast&lt;UAnimSequenceBase&gt;(
					UChooserFunctionLibrary::EvaluateChooser(
						this, 
						ChooserTable, 
						UAnimSequenceBase::StaticClass()));
				if (IsValid(Animation) &amp;&amp; !IsPlayingSlotAnimation(Animation, SlotName))
				{
					PlaySlotAnimationAsDynamicMontage(
						Animation, 
						SlotName,
						0.2f, 
						0.25f, 
						ScaledPlayRate_Montage, 
						1, 
						0.0f, 
						0.0f);

					const float AnimationAngle = FMath::Sign(TurnInPlaceAngle_Montage)
						* ( (FMath::Abs(TurnInPlaceAngle_Montage) &lt; 130.0f ) ? 90.0f : 180.0f);
					//	(实际旋转角度 / 动画的旋转角度) * 播放速率 = 旋转倍率 * 播放速率 = 修正后的旋转倍率
					TurnInPlaceAngleModifier_Montage = (TurnInPlaceAngle_Montage / AnimationAngle) * ScaledPlayRate_Montage;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// Sequence Then 1 独立执行，不受上面的动画触发条件影响。
	const float RotationAmount = GetCurveValue(RotationAmountCurveName);
	if (FMath::Abs(RotationAmount) &gt; 0.0f)
	{
      //乘上DeltaTime用来适应不同帧率
		AsBaseController-&gt;AddActorWorldRotation(FRotator(
			0.0f, 
			RotationAmount * 45.0f * DeltaTimeX, 
			0.0f));
	}
}
</code></pre>
<p>回到CT_TurnInPlaceStrafing，返回ScaledPlayRate用来控制蒙太奇的播放速率</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260916115604569-1821538497.png" alt="1789530103756" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="状态机-1">状态机</h2>
<p>IdleState</p>
<ul>
<li>让EnableTurnInPlace=1，也就是只有在Idle状态才会触发Strafing模式的原地转身</li>
<li>添加专属Slot</li>
<li>限制TurnInPlace的旋转修正倍率TurnInPlaceAngleModifier赋值给控制角色旋转的参数RotationAmount</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260916115604804-935444258.png" alt="1789530153810" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="效果-11">效果</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>均能正确转向</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260915212229706-1497265334.gif" alt="1789478504755" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="aim时两种旋转模式共享原地转身逻辑">Aim时两种旋转模式共享原地转身逻辑</h2>
<p>把这个Aim时播放原地转身蒙太奇的节点也放在Rotating模式下</p>

<h2 id="运动逻辑">运动逻辑</h2>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//Strafing模式下的Locomotion角度
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterRotation|Strafing")
	float VelocityLocomotionAngle = 0.0f;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//根据移动角度选择方向，并扩大当前前后方向的死区。
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintPure, Category = "CharacterRotation|Strafing", meta = (HideSelfPin = "true"))
	ECardinalDirection SelectCardinalDirection(
		ECardinalDirection CurrentDirection,
		float CurrentAngle,
		float DeadZone,
		bool bUseCurrentDirection) const;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">ECardinalDirection UBaseAnimInstance::SelectCardinalDirection(
	const ECardinalDirection CurrentDirection,
	const float CurrentAngle,
	const float DeadZone,
	const bool bUseCurrentDirection) const
{
	const float AbsoluteAngle = FMath::Abs(CurrentAngle);
	float FwdDeadZone = DeadZone;
	float BwdDeadZone = DeadZone;

	if (bUseCurrentDirection)
	{
		switch (CurrentDirection)
		{
		case ECardinalDirection::Backward:
			BwdDeadZone *= 2.0f;
			break;
		case ECardinalDirection::Forward:
			FwdDeadZone *= 2.0f;
			break;
		default:
			break;
		}
	}

	//[-45 - 死区， 45 + 死区] 
	if (AbsoluteAngle &lt;= 45.0f + FwdDeadZone)
	{
		return ECardinalDirection::Forward;
	}

	//[-∞, -135 - 死区]∪[130 + 死区, ∞]
	if (AbsoluteAngle &gt;= 135.0f - BwdDeadZone)
	{
		return ECardinalDirection::Backward;
	}

	//剩下的&lt;0就是左，&gt;0就是右
	return CurrentAngle &gt; 0.0f ? ECardinalDirection::Right : ECardinalDirection::Left;
}
</code></pre>
<p>在UpdateEssentialData中设置VelocityLocomotionAngle和VelocityCardinalDirection</p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void UBaseAnimInstance::UpdateEssentialData()
{
	//Sequence 0:	RotationMode
		//Sequence 1:	bIsMoving	LastVelocityRotation
		//Sequence 2:	bHasInput	LastInputRotation


	//Sequence 3:	bIsStrafing
	if (AsBaseController != nullptr)
	{
		bIsStrafing = RotationMode != ERotationMode::Rotating;

		VelocityLocomotionAngle = UKismetAnimationLibrary::CalculateDirection(MovementComponent-&gt;Velocity, AsBaseController-&gt;GetActorRotation());

		VelocityCardinalDirection = SelectCardinalDirection(VelocityCardinalDirection, VelocityLocomotionAngle, 10, bIsMoving);
	}

	//Sequence 4:	AnimPlaySpeed
}
</code></pre>
<p>死区取10，VelocityCardinalDirection分布如图</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260917193302107-719818029.png" alt="1789638059931" loading="lazy"></p>

<h1 id="part19-切换旋转模式时的伪spine效果">Part19 切换旋转模式时的伪Spine效果</h1>
<h2 id="角色蓝图-3">角色蓝图</h2>
<p>角色蓝图新增标志位bIsSwitchToRotating</p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//是否切换到Rotating模式
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "RotationMode")
	bool bIsSwitchToRotating = false;
</code></pre>
<p>IA_Strafe中切换到Rotating时为true，下一tick再重置为false</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260921162407930-1606692761.png" alt="1789963387541" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="动画蓝图-6">动画蓝图</h2>
<p>AnimSetup_Start中，记录Start状态时的旋转模式RotationMode_StartState</p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//Start状态下的RotationMode
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterRotation|StartState")
	ERotationMode RotationMode_StartState = ERotationMode::Rotating;
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260924172218274-1590558793.png" alt="1790234684758" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>AnimUpdate_Start中，</p>
<p>在Set Sequence之后声明bRotatingStartSwitchToStrafingCycle变量：Start状态时是Rotating模式&amp;当前Strafing模式</p>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//快速切换到Cycle
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterState")
	bool bRotatingStartSwitchToStrafingCycle;
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260924172218775-1007421896.png" alt="1790235678118" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>AnimSetup_Cycle中重置bRotatingStartSwitchToStrafingCycle为false</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260924172219001-89193054.png" alt="1790235721791" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="状态机start-cycle跳转条件">状态机Start&lt;-&gt;Cycle跳转条件</h2>
<p>Cycle-&gt;Start：bIsSwitchToRotating==true &amp; 当前状态已完全过渡到Cycle&amp;不是前进方向(否则前进时切换到Rotating也会触发TurnInPlace_Montage)</p>
<p>Start-&gt;Cycle：bRotatingStartSwitchToStrafingCycle</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3614909/202609/3614909-20260924172219603-1557695349.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>

<h2 id="动画蓝图updateessentialdata">动画蓝图UpdateEssentialData</h2>
<pre><code class="language-C++">	//角色胶囊体底部到地面的高度
	UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadWrite, Category = "CharacterMovement")
	float DistanceToFloor;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-C++">void UBaseAnimInstance::UpdateEssentialData()
{
	//Sequence 0:	RotationMode

		//Sequence 1:	bIsMoving	LastVelocityRotation


		//Sequence 2:	bHasInput	LastInputRotation


	//Sequence 3:	bIsStrafing


	//Sequence 4:	AnimPlaySpeed


	//Sequence 5:	DistanceToFloor（仅在下降时更新，其余情况保留原值）
	if (AsBaseController != nullptr &amp;&amp; MovementComponent != nullptr
		&amp;&amp; MovementComponent-&gt;MovementMode == MOVE_Falling
		&amp;&amp; MovementComponent-&gt;Velocity.Z &gt; -20.0f)
	{
		FFindFloorResult FloorResult;
		MovementComponent-&gt;ComputeFloorDist(
			AsBaseController-&gt;GetActorLocation(), 0.0f, 10000.0f, FloorResult, 35.0f);
		DistanceToFloor = FloorResult.FloorDist;
	}
}
</code></pre>
